name: Server Remember
author: Glutoblop
description: Remembers the last password that got you into each server (encrypted on disk) and adds a button to the server password prompt to fill it in.

changelog.0.1.5: Removed the Reconnect prefix from the main menu server label.
changelog.0.1.4: Mod Settings button in the pause menu: change this plugin's settings in game (one tab per plugin).
changelog.0.1.3: Main menu Reconnect option: last server's name, selected character and its icon
changelog.0.1.2: Key icon button to the right of the password box; always shown, greyed out when nothing is saved. Falls back to the last password used.
changelog.0.1.0: Initial release: per-server saved password, 'Use saved password' button on the password prompt.
